question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.



Scenario 1:

Image 1 (fix_center): A fixed camera positioned centrally captures this view of the robotic operation.


Image 2 (ego_right): The robot's right arm carries a camera that captures this first-person view of the manipulation.


Image 3 (ego_left): From the robot's left arm, a wrist camera records this view of the manipulation.

Two different scenarios show similar robotic manipulation tasks from various camera angles.
Scenario 1's Image 1 demonstrates the fix_center camera view.
Your challenge is to identify the equivalent image in Scenario 2 that captures the identical viewpoint.
Analyze the camera positioning and visual perspective in each Scenario 2 image.
Select the image number in Scenario 2 that matches the fix_center view from Scenario 1.
